note: Inter-station peer-to-peer speed-synchronisation pairs. masterStationId / slaveStationId are null and resolved is false because the DDR contains an unsettled naming ambiguity (see unresolvedReason). The UI must render 'Assignment unresolved', show the note, and NOT draw a directional master->slave arrow. Setting the two IDs and resolved:true must be the only change needed to make the directional relationship appear.

pairs.unresolvedReason: DDR names the master 'Kisiti'. The start-up sequence places Kisiti upstream of Kidaru (implying Sibiti IBPS-1); other passages read as Kisiriri IBPS-3, which is downstream. Master/slave assignment inverts depending on which is correct.

balancingTank.note: Kidaru balancing tank — the asset the sync loop protects
